executive_summary: Getinge delivered strong Q3 2025 results with 9.5% organic sales growth and improved margins despite significant headwinds from tariffs (-108 MSEK) and negative currency effects (-128 MSEK EBITA impact). All three business areas set quarterly sales records, with Acute Care Therapies leading on ventilator demand and ECLS consumables.
key_highlights: Organic sales growth of 9.5% - strongest quarterly performance in 2025
Adjusted EBITA margin improved 1.6 percentage points to 13.1%
CE Mark restored for Cardiosave intra-aortic balloon pump
V12 balloon expandable covered stent received approval for three additional indications
Free cash flow SEK 793 M, more than doubled vs Q3 2024
Paragonix now included organically after one year - expansion outside US accelerating

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: We have chosen to reiterate our financial target considering tariff levels to date
Average adjusted earnings per share growth: >12%

challenges.challenge: Tariff costs of approximately SEK -108 M in the quarter
Currency effects totaling SEK -236 M impact vs prior year

honesty_signals: Acknowledges need to absorb large share of tariff costs short-term
Openly discusses tough Q4 comparative figures ahead
Quantifies specific negative currency and tariff impacts

key_quotes.quote: We demonstrated strength in the third quarter with significant organic growth, improved profitability and cash flow - despite stronger headwinds from tariffs and negative currency effects
Short term we need to absorb a large share of the tariff costs
We are essentially well positioned to manage these geopolitical challenges by leveraging our leading position in key niches

key_narratives: Market consolidation driving ventilator demand in Acute Care Therapies
Sterile Transfer continuing strong double-digit growth in Life Science
Productivity improvements generating tangible results despite external headwinds
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management views Q3 as validation of resilience strategy, with operational improvements offsetting external headwinds. Focus on niche leadership and diversified supply chain as key competitive advantages.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Continued very strong performance in ventilators, ECLS therapy and Cardiac Surgery. CE Mark restored for Cardiosave.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Double-digit organic growth. Lead time for GSS/GEV sterilizers reduced by 20%, COGS for certain WIS capital goods reduced by 10%.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Growth in Infection Control and operating tables offset by decline in capital goods order intake.

operational_highlights: Lead time for GSS/GEV sterilizers reduced by more than 20%
COGS for certain WIS capital goods reduced by approximately 10%
Sweden's first fully automated CSSD at Malmo University Hospital inaugurated with Getinge T-DOC
Partnership with Philips for integrated anesthesia workstation in CE markets
concerns_mentioned: Surgical Workflows organic order intake declined despite strong tables and consumables
APAC order intake declined slightly due to tough comparables in Australia

risks.risk: Geopolitical risks including tariffs and trade barriers
Quality risks from regulatory perspective (CE certifications)
Supply chain interruptions and dependence on external suppliers
Information and data security / cybersecurity deficiencies

guidance.commentary: Guidance maintained considering tariff levels to date. Management well positioned to manage geopolitical challenges.
